about_the_game:
The initial version of "Lingua Fleur: Lily"
Content contains:
Main story with old character illustrations.

Note: You cannot use this version to access the afterstory content provided by other DLCs

As the artist has grown, the character illustrations for this work have been updated. But we think the old version is also a part of this work, and many players' memories of this game were made with the illustrations of the old version. So we keep the old version in this DLC, and you can also witness the growth and change of the artist!

We hope you like the way we handle it, thank you!
